extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Solutions, suspensions, colloids — Solution: particles dissolved completely, clear and transparent, does not settle (salt in water, sugar in water). Suspension: insoluble particles spread throughout, cloudy, particles settle on standing (sand in water, chalk in water). Colloid: particles dispersed but not dissolved, appears milky, particles do not settle (milk, fog, ink). (2) Separation of mixtures — mixtures can be separated because components have different properties (size, solubility, magnetism, boiling point). (3) Methods — Filtration: separates insoluble solid from liquid using filter paper (sand from water). Evaporation: separates soluble solid from liquid by heating (salt from water). Decantation: pours off liquid from settled solid (oil from water). Magnetic separation: separates magnetic materials (iron filings from sand). Distillation: boils liquid, condenses vapor to get pure liquid (pure water from salt water). Winnowing: separates lighter from heavier using wind (chaff from grain). Sieving: separates by particle size. (4) Water pollution and purification — Causes: factory waste, sewage, agricultural chemicals, plastic, oil spills. Effects: diseases (cholera, typhoid), harm to aquatic life, unsafe drinking water. Purification steps: sedimentation (let heavy particles settle), filtration (remove solids), boiling or chlorination (kill germs), storage in clean container. Misconceptions: 'a solution and a suspension are the same' (WRONG — in a solution the solid dissolves completely and the liquid is clear; in a suspension the solid does not dissolve and the liquid is cloudy), 'filtration can separate salt from water' (WRONG — filtration only separates insoluble solids; salt is dissolved so it passes through filter paper; use evaporation instead), 'boiling water removes all impurities' (WRONG — boiling kills germs but does not remove dissolved chemicals or heavy metals; distillation is needed for complete purification), 'milk is a solution' (WRONG — milk is a colloid; the fat particles are dispersed but not dissolved, making it appear milky), 'evaporation destroys the solid' (WRONG — evaporation leaves the solid behind as crystals; it only removes the liquid).
